name: Minecraft: Java Edition (Forge)
description: A Minecraft server with the Forge mod loader. Pick a game version, then a Forge version; put mods in the mods folder.

install.script:
#!/bin/sh
# Ionnet GSM install: Minecraft Forge. Runs as the instance user in /data.
set -eu
cd /data
echo "Downloading Forge installer ${MC_VERSION}-${LOADER_VERSION} ..."
curl -fsSL --retry 3 -o installer.jar "$INSTALLER_URL"
echo "Running the Forge installer (this downloads Minecraft and the libraries) ..."
java -jar installer.jar --installServer
rm -f installer.jar installer.jar.log
: > user_jvm_args.txt
if [ -f run.sh ]; then
  grep -o '@libraries[^ ]*unix_args.txt' run.sh | head -n1 > .gsm-launch
else
  jar="$(ls forge-*.jar 2>/dev/null | grep -v installer | head -n1 || true)"
  [ -n "$jar" ] || { echo "no forge server jar found after install" >&2; exit 1; }
  echo "-jar $jar" > .gsm-launch
fi
[ -s .gsm-launch ] || { echo "could not work out how to launch Forge" >&2; exit 1; }
echo "Launch arguments: $(cat .gsm-launch)"
echo "eula=${EULA:-false}" > eula.txt
[ -f server.properties ] || printf 'server-port=%s\nmotd=%s\n' "${GSM_PORT_GAME:-25565}" "${MOTD:-A Minecraft Server}" > server.properties
echo "Install complete."

variables.name: MC_VERSION
variables.label: Minecraft version
variables.description: The game version to install. Changing it needs a reinstall.

variables.name: LOADER_VERSION
variables.label: Forge version
variables.description: The Forge loader build for the chosen game version. Changing it needs a reinstall.

variables.name: EULA
variables.label: Accept the Minecraft EULA
variables.description: Set to true to accept the Minecraft End User License Agreement (https://aka.ms/MinecraftEULA). The server refuses to start otherwise.

variables.name: ONLINE_MODE
variables.label: Online mode
variables.description: Verify players against Mojang's servers. Turn off only for offline or proxied setups.

variables.name: LEVEL_SEED
variables.label: World seed
variables.description: Leave empty for a random seed. Only used when the world is first generated.

variables.name: JVM_FLAGS
variables.label: Extra JVM flags
variables.description: Garbage collector tuning appended to the java command. The heap size is set from the memory limit.
